passages.text: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God, saying: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
passages.sermon:
Jonah was a prophet.
The LORD was Jonah’s God.
A great fish swallowed Jonah.
Jonah was inside the fish.
Jonah prayed to the LORD from inside the fish.
Jonah said, “I was in trouble.
I called to the LORD.
The LORD answered me.
I was deep in distress, like being in the grave.
I cried out for help.
You, LORD, heard my voice.”
passages.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל יוֹנָ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו מִמְּעֵ֖י הַדָּגָֽה׃ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קָ֠רָאתִי מִצָּ֥רָה לִ֛י אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי מִבֶּ֧טֶן שְׁא֛וֹל שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ קוֹלִֽי׃

passages.text: For You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the current swirled about me; all Your breakers and waves swept over me.
passages.sermon:
Jonah was a prophet.
God sent a great fish to swallow Jonah.
Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
Jonah prayed to the LORD his God from inside the fish.
Jonah said to God, "You cast me into the deep."
I was in the heart of the seas.
The current swirled around me.
All Your breakers swept over me.
All Your waves passed over me.
passages.original: וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤נִי מְצוּלָה֙ בִּלְבַ֣ב יַמִּ֔ים וְנָהָ֖ר יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי כָּל־ מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְגַלֶּ֖יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: At this, I said, ‘I have been banished from Your sight; yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.’
passages.sermon:
Jonah was a prophet.
God sent Jonah to deliver a message.
Jonah disobeyed God.
God caused a great fish to swallow Jonah.
Jonah prayed to God from inside the fish.
Jonah said, “I have been banished from Your sight.”
Jonah felt separated from God.
Jonah also said, “Yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.”
Jonah hoped to see God’s holy temple again.
Jonah trusted God even in distress.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי נִגְרַ֖שְׁתִּי מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ אַ֚ךְ אוֹסִ֣יף לְהַבִּ֔יט אֶל־ הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: The waters engulfed me to take my life; the watery depths closed around me; the seaweed wrapped around my head.
passages.sermon:
Jonah was a prophet.
God sent a great fish to swallow Jonah.
Jonah prayed from inside the fish.
Water surrounded me.
The water rose up to my life.
Deep waters closed in around me.
Seaweed wrapped tightly around my head.
passages.original: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי מַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ תְּה֖וֹם יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי ס֖וּף חָב֥וּשׁ לְרֹאשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: To the roots of the mountains I descended; the earth beneath me barred me in forever! But You raised my life from the pit, O LORD my God!
passages.sermon:
Jonah is the speaker.
Jonah descended to the roots of the mountains.
The earth beneath him barred him in forever.
The LORD is Jonah’s God.
The LORD raised Jonah’s life from the pit.
passages.original: לְקִצְבֵ֤י הָרִים֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי הָאָ֛רֶץ בְּרִחֶ֥יהָ בַעֲדִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַתַּ֧עַל מִשַּׁ֛חַת חַיַּ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.
passages.sermon:
Jonah was a prophet.
Jonah was inside a great fish.
Jonah’s life was slipping away.
Jonah remembered the LORD.
Jonah prayed to God.
Jonah’s prayer reached God.
God’s holy temple is where Jonah’s prayer went.
passages.original: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֤ף עָלַי֙ נַפְשִׁ֔י אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה זָכָ֑רְתִּי וַתָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ תְּפִלָּתִ֔י אֶל־ הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
passages.sermon:
Some people hold on to worthless idols.
These idols have no value.
These people turn away from God’s loving devotion.
They leave behind the kindness God offers.

passages.text: But I, with the voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You. I will fulfill what I have vowed. Salvation is from the LORD!”
passages.sermon:
Jonah spoke to God.
Jonah was thankful.
Jonah said he would offer a sacrifice to God.
Jonah promised to keep his vow to God.
Jonah declared that salvation comes from the LORD.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּק֤וֹל תּוֹדָה֙ אֶזְבְּחָה־ לָּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָדַ֖רְתִּי אֲשַׁלֵּ֑מָה יְשׁוּעָ֖תָה לַיהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: And the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD spoke to the fish.
The fish obeyed the LORD.
The fish vomited Jonah onto dry land.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה לַדָּ֑ג וַיָּקֵ֥א אֶת־ יוֹנָ֖ה אֶל־ הַיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃פ
